criteria.name: Report presentation
criteria.reasoning: Logical headings and readable prose with executive summary. Figures/tables lack numbers/titles, reference formatting broken, Wikipedia used despite prohibition, in-text citations loosely matched.

technical_issues.issue: 600 km SSO inclination stated as 87.79 deg; correct ~97.8 deg. 87.79 deg is prograde, contradicts claimed retrograde near-polar SSO and Image 3 plot.
Kourou latitude stated as 45.05 deg N; actual ~5.2 deg N. Invalidates launch-window reasoning.
RAAN 27.33 deg claimed to indicate launch facility location; RAAN does not encode launch site and value unjustified.
Mean contact claimed almost twenty minutes; table mean 580.8 s (~9.7 min), max 770 s. Overstatement ~2x.

overall: Single-satellite GBR reef monitor with plausible architecture and STK support, but marred by critical SSO inclination error, location error, and incomplete operator/files/referencing compliance.

feedback.summary: You proposed a plausible single-satellite GBR reef-monitoring mission with STK modelling across launch, orbit and ground segments. To reach Accomplished you need to correct critical technical errors, fully define users and EOL, and tighten presentation and referencing with quantitative synthesis.
next_steps: Correct your Orbit SSO inclination from 87.79 deg to ~97.8 deg retrograde at 600 km to match Image 3, and fix your RAAN 27.33 deg launch-site logic.
Correct Kourou latitude from 45.05 deg N to ~5.2 deg N with revised launch reasoning, and correct your mean contact from almost twenty minutes to 580.8 s (~9.7 min) from your access table.
Explicitly define your operator versus customers in the Introduction, resolve your EOL manoeuvre contradiction, and add figure numbers/titles with matched Bibliography references without Wikipedia.

criteria.C3: You summarised polar sun-synchronous orbit for consistent illumination and Mt Pleasant for data receipt with Vega E caveat in your Conclusion. For Accomplished, move beyond restatement to detailed conclusions synthesising quantitative evidence on coverage, access and lifetime to prove mission benefit.
criteria.C4: Your Executive Summary and logical headings made your report readable. For Accomplished, add numbered figure/table titles, ensure in-text citations match your Bibliography, replace Wikipedia with approved sources, and use consistent academic formatting throughout.
